query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_references,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pack_version = 'hc_v1' THEN 1 END) as heritage_conservation,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pack_version = 'v3' OR pack_version IS NULL THEN 1 END) as other_packs
FROM v3_references;
